extraction.policy_summary: The Company states 'Yes' to having an equal opportunity policy per the RPwD Act 2016 -- the 'Equal Opportunities Policy' -- and provides a website link to it.
extraction.pwd_employee_count_details: As at end of financial year: 1 total differently abled employee (1 male, 100%, permanent; 0 female) out of 5,836 total employees; 0 differently abled workers out of 20,150 total workers.
extraction.physical_accessibility_measures: The Company states its corporate headquarters are accessible to differently abled individuals, including a dedicated entrance porch ramp, ground-level wheelchair availability, a wide-flap barrier security turnstile, a fully equipped wheelchair-accessible washroom, and elevators (used in place of escalators for main-lobby access) fitted with Assistive Control Panels and auditory/visual guidance systems designed to support visually impaired individuals. These measures are described only for the corporate headquarters, not other sites/offices.

evidence.quote: Yes. The Equal Opportunities Policy is available on our website at www.lodhagroup.com/esg-sustainablity-environmental-social-governance.
Total differently abled employees (D + E) 1 ... Total differently abled workers (F + G) 0

Our corporate headquarters are accessible to differently abled individuals. These include dedicated entrance porch ramp, ground-level wheelchair availability, a wide-flap barrier security turnstile and a fully equipped, wheelchair-accessible washroom... elevators are outfitted with Assistive Control Panels alongside both auditory and visual guidance systems specifically designed to support visually impaired individuals.
